newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samsung Elec limit up in early trade.
newsitem.headline: Samsung Elec limit up in early trade.

text.p: Shares of Samsung Electronics, a unit of South Korea's Samsung Group, opened Tuesday's trading at their upper limits on active buying by foreign investors, brokers said.
The shares rose 3,800 won, or 5.86 percent, to 68,600 won per share, they said.
"There has been positive news recently about U.S. high-tech companies and a recovery in 16-megabit DRAM prices overseas which turned around investor sentiment," said a Schroders Securities broker.
Analysts said the international spot price of 16-megabit DRAM chips has recovered to nearly $10 from about $8 a couple of weeks ago.

Brokers said about 1.8 million Samsung Electronic shares were made available to overseas investors on Tuesday when the foreign ownership ceiling was raised to 20 percent from the current 18 percent for most stocks.
